title: MakeUGC Alternatives: Pricing and Apps Like MakeUGC
summary: MakeUGC pricing explained, plus seven alternatives: self-serve AI UGC apps and done-for-you teams. Facts from each company's own site, checked October 27, 2026.
body_markdown:
## Self-serve apps like MakeUGC


These four keep you in control of every script and take. Our[best AI video ad generators guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ai-video-ad-generators) covers more tools, including Higgsfield and Meta's own Advantage+ creative.


### Arcads: scripted ads from a large AI actor library


As of October 2026, Arcads offers a library of more than 1,000 AI actors, lets you generate your own actor and have it hold your product or show your app, and lets you direct an actor's emotion by writing how you want it. It also has AI tools to edit, translate, extend, subtitle and upscale video. The[Arcads FAQ](https://help.arcads.ai/en/articles/17350051-arcads-faq) says its talking actors speak 74 languages and are based on real actors who gave consent and are paid for their likeness. It lists Starter, Creator, Pro, Scale and Business plans from 8,000 to 192,000 monthly credits, but no dollar prices, plus a 72-hour, 1,000-credit trial that needs a card (not charged during the trial) and moves to the Starter monthly plan unless you cancel.


**Consider it instead of MakeUGC when** your ads are mostly scripted talking-actor videos and you want a second actor library to compare. Confirm the price in your account, since Arcads does not publish one. Our[Arcads versus MakeUGC comparison](https://knowlify.com/articles/arcads-vs-makeugc) sets out a two-tool pilot with a worked cost-per-ad example.


### Creatify: from a product page to an ad


As of October 2026, Creatify's URL to Video takes a product page link (the sources it shows include Amazon, Shopify, Etsy and the App Store), pulls the page's assets, writes a script and produces a video ad with an AI avatar. The[Creatify pricing page](https://creatify.ai/pricing) lists a free plan with 10 credits a month (up to 2 video ads, with a watermark) and Standard at $15 a month with 55 credits, shown as $10 a month with its annual-plan discount. Manual edits such as text, captions and trims are free, anything that re-runs the AI uses credits, and paid-plan credits expire after two months.


**Consider it instead of MakeUGC when** you sell many products and want a first ad for each one straight from its product page.


### HeyGen: presenter avatars and translation


As of October 2026, HeyGen describes AI videos built around avatars, including a personal avatar of you, a prompt-based Video Agent and video translation across more than 175 languages and dialects. It lists marketing and sales promos among the videos you can make; its homepage does not mention ads specifically. The[HeyGen pricing page](https://www.heygen.com/pricing) lists a free plan with 3 watermarked videos a month, Creator at $29 a month ($24 a month billed annually) with 600 credits and 1080p export, and Pro at $49 a month with 1,000 credits and 4K export.


**Consider it instead of MakeUGC when** a founder or spokesperson avatar should deliver the message, or one ad needs to run in several languages.


### TopView: an agent that plans the video


As of October 2026, TopView calls itself an AI video agent for short films and marketing videos. You describe an idea or add a script, reference video or product URL, and it plans scenes, picks models, generates assets and keeps each shot editable on a canvas. It says it makes UGC-style ads with AI presenters and can analyze a reference video's style, rhythm, shot structure and hooks. The[TopView pricing page](https://www.topview.ai/pricing) lists Plus at $36 a month billed annually ($432 a year) with 100 credits a month. It lists no free plan, and unused credits do not roll over to the next month.


**Consider it instead of MakeUGC when** you want an agent to plan a video around an ad structure that already works for you. Only recreate reference ads you have the right to use.


## Done-for-you alternatives to MakeUGC


If the problem is the hours rather than the tool, a managed service takes on scripting, generation, editing and review, and you approve the results. Our[best AI UGC agencies guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ai-ugc-agencies) compares more providers with published prices; these two, along with Knowlify above, are the closest to what a MakeUGC buyer is used to.


### Managed by MakeUGC: the same platform, run for you


Before switching, price MakeUGC's own managed option. As of October 2026, the[MakeUGC Enterprise page](https://makeugc.ai/enterprise) describes Managed by MakeUGC as human-led strategy with AI production on MakeUGC. A creative strategist learns your brand and agrees angles with you, the team researches your category and generates personas, hooks and scripts, and a strategist reviews every ad before it ships. Finished ads land in a dashboard where you comment, approve and request same-day revisions. Its comparison table lists a 48-hour turnaround, 40 to 160+ videos a month and a custom retainer, and the booking form says pricing is shared on the call and set to your ad spend. The page does not say MakeUGC runs your ad campaigns.


**Consider it when** you like what MakeUGC makes but nobody on your team has time to operate it.


### Creatify Studio: a published per-video price


As of October 2026,[Creatify Studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) describes a similar human-led, AI-produced service: its team and AI research your category and produce personas, concepts, hooks, scripts and full video ads, and a creative expert reviews every ad before it ships. Its comparison table lists $100 to $200 per video, a 48-hour turnaround and 25 to 100+ videos a month, and the page offers unlimited same-day revisions and says it works with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap and Amazon. The Studio page does not say whether its ads use AI avatars or real creators, or that Studio runs campaigns.


**Consider it when** you want a published per-video price before you talk to sales.


## How to choose between MakeUGC and an alternative


1. **Decide who operates it.** If someone on your team can write scripts, generate, review and edit every week, stay self-serve. If not, compare managed options before buying another plan.
2. **Match the starting point.** For a script and an actor, compare MakeUGC and Arcads. For a product page, try Creatify. For a presenter in many languages, try HeyGen. For a reference ad, try TopView or MakeUGC's Ad Remake.
3. **Check the limits that affect your batch.** Look at export resolution, parallel generations, credit rollover, trial conversion and the refund window before you pay.
4. **Run one brief through two options.** Use the same script, product assets and pass criteria: accurate product, clear speech, natural delivery, readable captions and the export you need. Count attempts, accepted ads and hands-on hours.
5. **Price per accepted ad.** Add the plan, extra credits and your team's hours, then divide by the ads you would actually run. Compare that with a managed quote plus your own review time, and keep cash spending and staff hours in separate columns.
6. **Keep scripts honest.** An AI presenter is not a customer, so never script one to claim personal results, and check each product's terms for paid-ad use.


## Key takeaways


- Our top pick is Knowlify for teams that want finished Facebook and Instagram ads without running a tool: about 25 a week, scripted, produced and checked by a person.
- As of October 2026, MakeUGC costs $29 to $79 a month billed yearly or $59 to $149 billed monthly; credits do not roll over, and refunds are discretionary and must be requested within three business days.
- For another self-serve app, choose by starting point: Arcads for scripted actor ads, Creatify for product pages, HeyGen for presenters and translation, TopView for reference-led planning.
- If the bottleneck is time, compare done-for-you options: Knowlify, Managed by MakeUGC and Creatify Studio.
- Compare cost per accepted ad, not cost per credit, and keep media spend separate.


## FAQ


### Does MakeUGC have a free plan?


As of October 2026, MakeUGC lists no free plan, but any plan can be tried for $1. Its trial policy describes a 72-hour trial that converts to the paid plan at the standard price unless you cancel before it ends, and the $1 fee is non-refundable.


### Do MakeUGC credits roll over?


No. As of October 2026, its pricing page says credits are shared between the studio and the API, refresh monthly and do not roll over. Each generation's cost depends on the model, duration and resolution.


### What is the cheapest MakeUGC alternative?


As of October 2026, Creatify and HeyGen list free plans with watermarked exports. Among paid plans, Creatify Standard lists $15 a month, HeyGen Creator $29 a month and TopView Plus $36 a month billed annually, while Arcads publishes no dollar price. The cheapest plan is not always the cheapest finished ad.


### Is there a done-for-you version of MakeUGC?


Yes. As of October 2026, MakeUGC's Enterprise plan includes an optional Managed by MakeUGC service, in which a strategist runs production and reviews every ad, with a listed 48-hour turnaround and custom pricing shared on a call.


### Is Knowlify an app like MakeUGC?


No. Knowlify is a done-for-you AI ads agency for Facebook and Instagram. Our team scripts, produces and checks about 25 finished ads a week, using AI presenters rather than real creators, with optional campaign management in your own Meta ad account. To get a quote,[book a 30-minute call](https://knowlify.com/book) .
